scene_type: 2D (per inputs.json; rendered 3D-looking warehouse, but camera faces the wall / motion plane)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 at t = 0
pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (background identical in all frames; difference vs frame-39 background is zero outside the box)
camera.perspective: single wall plane facing the camera; slight perspective on props (box's top/side faces visible at start). Box moves in a plane parallel to the image; one px->m scale is appropriate.
